definitions.explanation: Hanging laundry to dry inside the house rather than outdoors. Common during rainy season, winter, or in apartments without balconies.

examples.english: On rainy days, I dry the laundry indoors.

examples.japanese: {室内干|しつないぼ}しだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{乾|かわ}き→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧にくい。
examples.english: Laundry is hard to dry when hung indoors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{室内干|しつないぼ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{除湿機|じょしつき}→除湿機：06492_joshitsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: During the rainy season, indoor drying continues for days, so a dehumidifier is essential.

notes:
Hanging laundry to dry inside rather than outdoors. Especially common during ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season), in winter, and in apartments without balconies.

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧ (indoors) + {干|ほ}し (drying).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {室内干|しつないぼ}し⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for indoor drying (detergent, rack, etc.)
- ⟦{部屋干|へやぼ}し→部屋干し：29859_heyaboshi⟧: room drying (casual synonym)
- ⟦{生乾|なまがわ}き→生乾き：16268_namagawaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い: musty smell from incomplete drying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外干|そとぼ}し / ⟦{天日干|てんぴぼ}し→天日干し：21115_tenpiboshi⟧: sun-drying outdoors

TIPS:
Using a ⟦{除湿機|じょしつき}→除湿機：06492_joshitsuki⟧ (dehumidifier), ⟦{扇風機|せんぷうき}→扇風機：05069_senpuuki⟧ (fan), or ⟦{部屋干|へやぼ}し→部屋干し：29859_heyaboshi⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ (indoor-drying detergent) helps prevent odor.
